gaps.current: PostgreSQL Hub and production packaging-worker startup install transaction-bound notification intents for the documented pending-review, authority-change, Plan-failure, aborted-promotion and accepted-recall transitions. Source/audit/intent commit together, consent candidates are frozen and current authority is rechecked at admission and external delivery. Restart and lost-ack recovery are bounded by retained intents; queue/delivery metrics and alert rules exist, but no historical backfill or configured file-store delivery is claimed.

Request metrics, bounded access logs, notification signals, dashboards and runbooks are merged. Opt-in OpenTelemetry OTLP/HTTP spans link Plan decisions to Agent execution; default log correlation exports no spans. Shipped Prometheus rules passed 21 synthetic scenarios and four harmful controls. Running-fleet selectors, collector/dashboard integration, thresholds and capacity/SLO qualification remain open.

Ordered transactional migration ledger, schema verification, populated-data and mixed-version rehearsals exist. Down migrations are intentionally absent. Earlier identical-tree and current individual source-head Go/race/PostgreSQL receipts are bounded as described above; no combined-baseline full CI, production capacity or target-cluster upgrade qualification is inferred.

A PostgreSQL dump/restore drill, append-only audit chain, verified JSONL export/offline check, bounded audit event reads with sanitized errors and opt-in scheduled checkpoint verifier exist. Independent checkpoint custody, deployment backups and secret copies belong to the operator. Deployment execution and capacity remain unestablished. Live-ledger pruning requires a separately accepted archive/expiry/retrieval design.
Connected recall roll-off exists; disconnected targets do not receive source recall metadata through the Bundle resource set. Installation packaging is not evidence of disconnected fleet operation.

The Release model does not represent the application storage/schema compatibility needed to prove that rollback is safe. Controller storage migration rehearsals do not provide that tenant-application guarantee.
Product-owned SLO monitor resources and their automatic recall policy remain unmodelled. Internal liveness probes and reconciliation metrics are different capabilities.

Namespaced Spoke RBAC, Agent credential inventory/expiry, durable revocation with per-request rechecks and a two-root CA rehearsal are implemented. PostgreSQL cutoff monotonicity/concurrency, replica convergence and atomic audited removal were verified on PostgreSQL 18.6. Cert-manager enrolment, mounted-certificate rotation and target-cluster lifecycle remain unexercised. A bounded threat model, selected control mapping and an uncommissioned external-review brief are merged; independent review, FIPS boundary decisions and exercised tenant authority remain open.

Shape, exact image coverage and scan freshness are enforced, but a fresh supplied assessment is retained without a Hub-witnessed source binding. PR #277 deliberately closed only freshness. External suppression references must not be mistaken for internal Plan approvals; the lost trust-policy remainder is reissued separately.

baselineSummary: The merged baseline still has thirteen unary methods across eleven protobuf sources. Full Environment and Plan transport/caller migration remain #391/#392/#394: the Environment detail contract and adapter in candidate #1129 are excluded from this merged baseline. Since the previous source review, Product configuration codecs, overlays, default resolution, rendering and cross-document checks, manifest validation and immutable Release translation moved behind their owning compatibility packages; Catalog retains native reference/version/channel rules. Original carrier aliases and facade retirement remain #428 work, and ADR0020 remains proposed. The full Environment REST read now shares a narrow authorized catalog helper; this alone mounts no new RPC. Existing Space query parameters are retained by native operator selection, and composer focus remains bound to its owned draft. Earlier notification, audit, Agent credential, UDS status, exact artifact, populated-data and browser-journey evidence remains bounded by its original receipts. The process-startup/SSE fixture repairs from #1109 are merged; their qualified Trunk44486797843/Docs44486797820 receipt is historical, not a receipt for another tree. #1053 remains closed after upstream advisory withdrawal, not a patched version or waiver. Full local dependency qualification remains #581, frozen HiGHS closure #590, and published-package, isolated-worker, real-provider and deployment acceptance remain open. This evidence refresh and candidate #1129 are excluded from the named source baseline.
